newsitem.title: UK: Planet Hollywood plans London, NY rock restaurants.
newsitem.headline: Planet Hollywood plans London, NY rock restaurants.

text.p: Robert Earl, president and chief executive of restaurant chain Planet Hollywood International Inc. is planning to set up new restaurants in London and New York with a rock music theme, the Guardian newspaper said on Tuesday.

The newspaper said that Earl's plans, revealed in an interview with the European Business News television channel, would hit Rank Group Plc which owns the rights to the Hard Rock Cafe music restaurants.
The report said Earl, who teamed up with movie stars Arnold Schwarzenegger and Sylvester Stallone for the Planet Hollywood restaurants, was expected to work with top music stars.
